स: स स, originally ‘One.’  I. See तद्; in the Vedas appears also the loc. सस्मिन्।  II. As former part of comp. nouns.  1. With; see स-कमल, adj. With lotus flowers.  2. The same, like, equal; see स-धर्मन्, adj. Of the same caste, etc. -- Cf. σ in σήμερον, ὁ, ἡ, οἱ, αἱ, ἑ in ἕεις, εἷς (e. g. in ἑ-ϝενς), ἁ- (e. g. in ἁ-πλοῦς), ἀ- (e. g. in ἀδελϕός), ὀ- (e. g. in ὄ-πατρος); Lat. sum = eum, sam = eam, -sum, sem- in semper, sim-in simplex; Goth. sa, so, A.S. se, sco.

सभाज्: सभाज् सभाज्, i. 10 (rather a denomin. derived from a noun, *सभाज्, i. e. स-भज्), Par.  1. To serve, to worship, Rām. 5, 8, 20.  2. To honour, to beautify, Utt. Rāmac. 105, 5.  3. † To exhilarate.  4. † To show.
सभाजन: सभाजन सभाज् + अन, n.  1. Courtesy, politeness.  2. Honour, Mālav. 74, 10 (thanks).
सभासद्: सभासद् सभा-सद्, and सभासद सभा-सद् + अ, m.  1. An assistant at an assembly, Rām. 2, 5, 24 (सद्); Pañc. i. d. 336 (सद).  2. A judge, Man. 8, 12 (सद्).
सभास्तार: सभास्तार सभास्तार, i. e. सभा-आ -स्तृ + अ, m. An assistant at an as-sembly, MBh. 2, 1787.
सभिक: सभिक सभिक, i. e. सभा + इक, m. The keeper of a gaming-house, Daśak. in Chr. 185, 20; Mṛcch. 33, 24.
सभ्य: सभ्य सभ्य, i. e. सभा + य,  I. adj.  1. Relating to an assembly, fit for it, Ragh. 1, 55; polite, Pañc. i. d. 294 (cf. Bhartṛ. 3, 57; सभ्य-इतर, vulgar).  2. Trusted, faithful.  II. m.  1. An assistant at an assembly of scholars, Rājat. 5, 32; of courtiers, 86; of judges, Pañc. 40, 23.  2. A person of honour-able parentage, Bhaṭṭ. 1, 13,  3. The keeper of a gaming-house.  4. The servant of a keeper of a gaming-house (?), Daśak. in Chr. 186, 4. -- Cf. O.H.G. sibba; A.S. sib, sibbe, ge-sib; Goth. trasti-sibja, adoptatio, ga-sibjôn, reconciliare, un-sibja, iniqua; O.H.G. sibbi, sibbo, ga-sibbo, ga-sibbôt.
सम्: † 1. सम् सम्, स्तम् स्तम्, i. 1, Par.  1. To be unconfused.  2. To be confused. i. 10, समय, स्तमय, Par. To be confused.

2. सम् स + म् (acc. sing. n. of स),  1. prep. With, only in the Veda, Chr. 290, 8 = Rigv. i. 64, 8.  2. Combined and compounded with verbs and their derivatives, and compounded with nouns, With, together, much, very, wholly, beautifully. When followed by a prefix, it is generally without a special signification; e. g. सम्-उद्-क्षिप्, Pañc. 43, 8.
सम: सम स + म,  I. adj.  1. Even, plain, Śāk. 5, 14; Pañc. ii. d. 188.  2. Same, Hit. 116, 18.  3. Equal, MBh. 10, 622; समं कृ, To balaṇce, to pay, Man. 8, 177.  4. Convenient, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 1880; Nalod. 4, 8 (voice, neither too low nor too loud).  5. Straight, Śāk. d. 9.  6. Looking on unmoved, (with gen. and loc.), MBh. 1, 1061; 1942.  7. Impartial, indifferent, Lass. 6, 16.  8. Mean, common, Man. 7, 85; Hit. pr. d. 42, M.M. (not pre-eminent).  9. Like, similar, Chr. 8, 27 (मया, Like myself).  10. Good, Chr. 12, 28; vir-tuous.  11. A purchaser at a fair price, Man. 9, 287.  12. Full, complete.  13. All, whole, entire (follows the pro-nominal declension).  II. °मम्, A. adv.  1. With (with instr.), Rājat. 5, 216; together, Śiś. 9, 24; Vikr. 88, 17.  2. Equally, Hit. iii. d. 49; Vedāntas. in Chr. 208, 18.  3. Like, Johns. Sel. 15, 55 (with loc. ?).  4. In the same way, Śiś. 9, 44.  5. Conformable to, Pañc. 25, 14.  6. Entirely, ib. 63, 1.  B. prep. (with instr.), With, Hit. i. d. 79, M.M.; together with, Pañc. ii. d. 200.  III. f. मा, A year, Man. 4, 26.  IV. n. Level plain, Man. 1, 24.  -- Comp. अ-, 1. uneven, Kir. 5, 7. 2. unequal, Man. 10, 73. 3. incomparable, Kathās. 23, 32. चतुःसम, i. e. चतुर्-, adj. having four even or smooth (members of the body), Rām. 5, 32, 13. -- Cf. Goth. sama, and sama-, e. g. in sama-frathjis; A.S. same, sam-; Goth. samana; A.S. somne, samne; Goth. samath; A.S. sámod; Goth. sums, and A.S. sum, quidam; Lat. similis, simul, semel, sem-per, singuli; ὁμός, ὁμοῖος, ὅμοιος, ὁμαλός, ἁμᾷ, ἅμα, μία, μέν (cf. स).
समक्षम्: समक्षम् सम्-अक्ष + म्, adv. Eye to eye, in presence of, Śāk. 97, 10; Hit. 99, 10; Mālat. 47, 3.
समग्र: समग्र सम्-अग्र, adj.  1. Entire, complete, Megh. 57; full, Hiḍ. 3, 13.  2. All, Rām. 3, 49, 37.  -- Comp. अ-, adj. not full-grown, Vikr. d. 124.
समचित्तत्व: समचित्तत्व सम-चित्त + त्व, n.  1. Equanimity.  2. Indifference.
समज: समज सम्-अज् + अ,  I. m.  1. A multi-tude of beasts.  2. A number of block-heads.  II. n. A forest.
समज्या: समज्या सम्-अज् + या, f. An assembly.
समञ्जस: समञ्जस समञ्जस, i. e. सम्-अञ्जस् (cf. अञ्जसा), + अ,  I. adj.  1. Proper, right, fit, Johns. Sel. 5, 28 ( न-अति-, Not very proper, f. सा; MBh. 1, 5832, f. सी).  2. Correct, true.  3. Virtuous, good, Kir. 14, 12.  4. Experienced.  II. n.  1. Propriety.  2. Correct evidence, Man. 8, 256.  -- Comp. अ-,  I. adj. unfit, unskilled, Utt. Rāmac. 95, 12; incor-rect, Mālat. 162, 10.  II. सम्, adv. un-becomingly, MBh. 2, 2100.  III. n. impropriety, an abominable act, Pañc. in Weber, Ind. St. iii. 371, 15.
समता: समता सम + ता, f.  1. Sameness, similarity.  2. Equality, Pañc. ii. d. 90 (स्व-जाति-समतां गत, Grown equal to his kind).  3. State of a com-mon (not pre-eminent) person, Hit. pr. d. 42, M.M.  4. Equanimity, Man. 6, 44.  5. Right decision, Man. 8, 178.  6. Perfectness, Pañc. v. d. 83.
समतिक्रम: समतिक्रम सम्-अति-क्रम् + अ, m.  1. Transgressing.  2. Omission, Man. 11, 203.
समत्व: समत्व सम + त्व, n.  1. Equality, Bhag, 2, 48.  2. Identity, Pañc. i. d. 468.
समधिक: समधिक सम्-अधिक, adj.  1. Ex-ceeding, Megh. 100.  2. Abundant, plentiful, Utt. Rāmac. 90, 4.
समन: समन समन, probably सम्-अन् + अ, m.  1. Zeal.  2. A diligent man, Chr. 287, 6 = Rigv. i. 48, 6.
समनुज्ञान: समनुज्ञान समनुज्ञान, i. e. सम् -अनु-ज्ञा + अन, n.  1. Assent.  2. Per-mission.
समनुव्रत: समनुव्रत सम्-अनु-व्रत, adj. En-tirely devoted to, Nal. 13, 55 (with acc.).
समन्त: समन्त सम्-अन्त,  I. adj.  1. From every part, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 1446; en-tire.  2. All.  II. Abl. तात्, adv.  1. From every part, Pañc. 51, 18.  2. All round, on every side, Mālat. 158, 4; Pañc. 230, 16; Chr. 4, 20.  3. Com-pletely, Pañc. 148, 12.  III. m. Limit, boundary.
समन्ततस्: समन्ततस् समन्त + तस्, adv.  1. All round, on every side, Hit. ii. d. 158.  2. Wholly, Man. 3, 58.
समन्वय: समन्वय समन्वय, i. e. सम्-अनु-इ + अ, m.  1. Natural succession.  2. Con-nected sequence, consequence, Lass. 2. ed. 46, 31.  3. Conjunction with each other, Bhāg. P. 3, 26, 49.
समभिसरण: समभिसरण समभिसरण, i. e. सम्-अभि-सृ + अन, n.  1. Approaching.  2. Seeking.  3. Endeavouring to gain.
समभिहार: समभिहार समभिहार, i. e. सम् -अभि-हृ + अ, m.  1. Repetition.  2. Ex-cess, surplus.
सममय: सममय सम + मय, adj., f. यी, Proceeding from the same cause.
समय: समय समय, i. e. सम्-इ + अ, m.  1. Agreement, Pañc. 193, 13; treaty, Pañc. 24, 25; contract, bargain.  2. Engagement, Chr. 58, 2; appointment.  3. Religious obligation, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 304.  4. Established moral or ceremonial custom, Chr. 19, 4.  5. Rule, Man. 9, 273; law, Hit. ii. d. 45, M.M.  6. Condition, Nal. 13, 67.  7. Order, in-struction.  8. Oath, Sāv. 4, 17.  9. Sign, hint, indication.  10. Proper time for anything, season, Kir. 2, 28.  11. Opportunity, leisure.  12. Time, Vikr. 56, 1; Pañc. 229, 10.  13. Same time, Chr. 7, 15.  14. Limit, boundary.  15. Demonstrated conclusion, and con-clusion in general, Daśak. in Chr. 180, 8.  -- Comp.. ऋतु-, m. season proper for conception, Pañc. 74, 18. यथा-स-मय + म्, adv. according to established custom, Johns. Sel. 10, 20. लग्न-, m. auspicious time, Pañc. 129, 16.
समया: समया समया, adv. and prep. with acc.,  I. (old instr. of सम).  1. With-in, midst.  2. Near, Vārt. ad Pāṇ. ii. 3, 2; Nalod. 4, 8.  II. (old instr. of समय).  1. At a fixed time.  2. Season-ably, in due time. -- Cf. ἁμᾷ, ἅμα.
समयाध्युषित: समयाध्युषित समयाध्युषित, i. e. समय-अध्युषित (vb. 1. वस्, with अधि), n. A time at which neither stars nor sun are visible, Man. 2, 15.
समर: समर समर, i. e. सम्-ऋ + अ,  I. m. and n. War, battle, Hit. 106, 10.  II. m. A proper name, Rājat. 5, 25.
समर्थ: समर्थ सम्-अर्थ,  I. adj., f. था।  1. Proper, fit, Pañc. 169, 10.  2. Allowed, Man. 4, 186.  3. Made proper, prepared, Pañc. 121, 24.  4. Able, Hit. 31, 3, M.M.; adequate to.  5. Strong, power-ful, Pañc. iii. d. 54.  6. Connected in sense.  II. m. The construction of words.  -- Comp. अ-, adj. 1. not ade-quate, Vedāntas. in Chr. 215, 11. 2. unable, Hit. 32, 4, M.M. अति-, adj. very strong, Hit. 83, 13.
समर्थता: समर्थता समर्थ + ता, f.  1. Ade-quacy.  2. Ability.  3. Strength, power.  4. Signification of terms.
समर्थन: समर्थन सम्-अर्थ् + अन, m.  1. Re-conciling differences, allaying a dis-pute.  2. Perseverance in an arduous undertaking.  3. Deliberation, deciding on the propriety or impropriety of any-thing.  4. Objecting, objection.
समर्धक: समर्धक समर्धक, i. e. सम्-ऋध् + अक, adj. Granting a boon.
समर्पण: समर्पण समर्पण, i. e. सम्-ऋ, Caus., + अन, n. Delivering, consigning, handing over, Kathās. 4, 109; Rājat. 5, 299.
समवतार: समवतार समवतार, i. e. सम्-अव -तॄ + अ, m. A place of pilgrimage at a sacred stream, Kir. 5, 7.
समवाय: समवाय समवाय, i. e. सम्-अव-इ + अ, m.  1. Multitude, Pañc. 130, 7; aggregate; meeting, Daśak. in Chr. 180, 14.  2. Assembly, Man. 4, 108.  3. In-timate and constant relation, Bhāṣāp. 1, 58; as of yarn and the cloth made of it, the individual and its species, etc.  4. Intimate union, Śāk. 108, 10; union, Pañc. i. d. 376.
समवायिन्: समवायिन् समवायिन्, i. e. सम-वाय + इन्,  I. adj.  1. Aggregated.  2. Connected intimately, Bhāṣāp. 16; 17.  II. n. Intimate and inseparable cause, as thread of cloth.  -- Comp. अ-, adj. the non-intimate cause, as the conjunc-tion of two halves for a jar, Sch. ad Bhāṣāp. 17.
समष्टि: समष्टि समष्टि, i. e. सम्-अक्ष् + ति, f. Totality, Vedāntas. in Chr. 204, 13.
समसन: समसन सम्-अस् + अन, n.  1. Com-bination.  2. Formation of compound terms.  3. Contraction.
समस्थ: समस्थ सम-स्थ, adj.  1. Even.  2. Like, similar.
समस्या: समस्या सम्-अस् + या (fem. of the ptcple. fut. pass. of सम्- 2. अस्), f.  1. The part of a stanza given to another person to complete it.  2. The giving to another person part of a stanza, and requiring him to complete it.
समांश: समांश समांश, i. e. सम-अंश,  I. m. An equal part.  II. adj. Entitled to an equal share.
समांशिन्: समांशिन् समांशिन्। i. e. समांश + इन्, adj. sbst. A co-heir, entitled to an equal share.
समांसमीना: समांसमीना समांसमीना, i. e. स-म + म्-समा + म् + ईन (see सम), f. A cow bearing a calf every year.
समाकर्षिन्: समाकर्षिन् समाकर्षिन्, i. e. सम् -आ-कृष् + अ + इन्,  I. adj. Possessing a diffusive fragrance.  II. m., f. णी, n. A scent spreading afar, Amarakoṣa.
समाकार: समाकार समाकार, i. e. सम-आकार, adj. Like in appearance. Pañc. i. d. 211.
समाकुलत्व: समाकुलत्व सम्-आकुल + त्व, n. Agi-tation, anxiety.
समागति: समागति समागति, i. e. सम्-आ-गम् + ति, f.  1. Arrival.  2. Union.  3. Meet-ing.  4. (i. e. सम-आगति), Similar pro-gress or condition.
समागम: समागम सम्-आ-गम् + अ, m.  1. Ar-rival, Vikr. 10, 21 (return); approach.  2. Union, Vikr. d. 29; junction, Pañc. 128, 3; assembly, Pañc. 196, 16.  3. Association, intercourse, Hit. pr. d. 42, M.M.  4. Encountering, meeting, Pañc. 161, 12.  -- Comp. धूर्त-, m. the assemblage of rogues, title of a drama, Lass. 66, 1.
समाघात: समाघात समाघात, i. e. सम्-आ -हन्, Caus., + अ, m.  1. War, battle.  2. Killing.
समाचार: समाचार समाचार, i. e.  I. सम्-आ -चर् + अ, m.  1. Proper practice or conduct, MBh. 5, 2688; Pañc. 24, 10.  2. Proceeding, conduct, Draup. 9, 17.  3. Going, way, Pañc. 109, 11.  4. In-formation, report.  II. सम-आचार, adj. Equal in virtuous conduct, Pañc. iii. d. 140.  -- Comp. मोक्ष-क्रिया-, adj. affording a way for liberating, Pañc. 109, 11. वृथा-कुल-, adj. descended from a low family and ill-behaved, Johns. Sel. 20, 97. साधु-, adj. well-behaved, Pañc. 41, 17.
समाज: समाज समाज, i. e. सम्-अज् + अ, m.  1. A multitude, MBh. 1, 5698; a number.  2. An assembly, Pañc. 158, 7.  3. A convivial meeting.  4. An ele-phant.  -- Comp. द्यूत-, m. an assembly of gamesters, Daśak. in Chr. 185, 16. प्रेक्षा-, m. the crowd at theatres, Man. 9, 84.
समाजिक: समाजिक समाजिक, i. e. समाज + इक, m. A spectator, Mālat. 4, 14.
समादान: समादान समादान, i. e. सम्-आ-दा + अन, n.  1. Receiving suitable dona-tions.  2. Taking.  3. The daily ob-servances of the जैन sect.
समादेश: समादेश समादेश, i. e. सम्-आ-दिश् + अ, m. Advice, Pañc. i. d. 261.
समाधान: समाधान समाधान, i. e. सम्-आ -धा + अन, n.  1. Restraining the senses and confining the mind to contempla-tion on the true nature of spirit, Vedāntas. in Chr. 203, 13, cf. 18; con-templation, Daśak. in Chr. 182, 5.  2. Promising, declaring.
समाधि: समाधि समाधि, i. e. सम्-आ-धा (cf. निधि), m.  1. Composing or reconciling differences.  2. Storing corn.  3. The joint of the neck, Kir. 16, 21.  4. A tomb.  5. Agreement, promise.  6. Requital.  7. Restraining the senses and confining the mind to contemplation on the true nature of spirit, Vedāntas. in Chr. 203, 18; 216, 1, cf. 217, 21; contemplation, Bhāg. P. 5, 18, 1; devotion, Pañc. 162, 24.  8. A religious vow or obli-gation, Kumāras. 3, 24.  9. Silence.  10. Demonstrated conclusion.  11. At-tempting impossibilities.
समाधिन्: समाधिन् समाधिन्, i. e. समाधि + इन्, adj. Absorbed in contemplation, meditating, Bhag. 4, 24.
समाधिस्थ: समाधिस्थ समाधि-स्थ, adj. De-voted to meditation, Pañc. 162, 23.
समान: समान A. i. e. स-मान,  I. adj., f. ना and नी।  1. Like, similar, equal, Vikr. d. 110; Pañc. ii. d. 26.  2. Same, Chr. 295, 10 = Rigv. i. 92, 10; Man. 7, 163; Vedāntas. in Chr. 208, 21; one, uni-form.  3. Good, virtuous.  4. Honoured, Lass. 1, 12.  II. अम्, adv. Equally (with instr.), Kir. 18, 4.  III. m. A friend, Nalod. 2, 16.  B. i. e. सम्-अन् + अ, m. One of the vital airs, that which is essential to digestion, Vedāntas. in Chr. 207, 12.
समानता: समानता समान + ता, f.  1. Same-ness, equality.  2. Community of kind or quality.
समानोदर्य: समानोदर्य समानोदर्य, i. e. सम्-आन-उदर + य, m. A brother of whole blood.
समापक: समापक सम्-आप् + अक, adj.  1. Finishing, completing.  2. Killing.
समापन: समापन सम्-आप् + अन, n.  1. Con-clusion, completion, Man. 5, 88.  2. A section, a chapter.  3. Profound medi-tation.  4. Acquisition.  5. Killing.
समापिपयिषु: समापिपयिषु समापिपयिषु, i. e. सम्-आपिपयिष (desider. of the Caus. of आप्), + ऊ, adj. Wishing to complete, MBh. 1, 6872.
समाप्ति: समाप्ति सम्-आप् + ति, f.  1. End, Man. 2, 244.  2. Perfection, accomplish-ment, Rām. 2, 43, 31; Bhartṛ. 3, 98.  3. Reconciling differences, putting an end to disputes.
समाप्तिक: समाप्तिक समाप्ति + क,  I. adj.  1. Completing, final.  2. One who has finished the whole, Man. 3, 145.  II. m.  1. A finisher.  2. One who has com-pleted a whole course of holy study.
समाम्नाय: समाम्नाय समाम्नाय, i. e. सम्-आ -म्ना + अ, m. Enumeration, Prātiś. ed. Regnier, Journ. As. 1856, p. 187.  -- Comp. पशु-, m. works on animal sacrifices, Utt. Rāmac. 114, 6.
समाय: समाय समाय, i. e. सम्-इ + अ, m.  1. A visit.  2. Arrival, Mālat. 170, 2.
समायोग: समायोग समायोग, i. e. सम्-आ-युज् + अ, m.  1. Union, Lass. 2. ed. 65, 6; junction, connection.  2. Aiming with (a bow), Rām. 1, 67, 10.  3. Heap, multitude.  4. Cause, motive, object.
समारम्भ: समारम्भ समारम्भ, i. e. सम्-आ -रभ् + अ, m.  1. Commencement, be-ginning, Pañc. ii. d. 196.  2. Under-taking, Chr. 7, 14; Pañc. 183, 2.  3. Using, Pañc. ii. d. 146.  4. An unguent, Sch. Śāk. ap. Böhtl. 211, ad 18.
समारम्भण: समारम्भण समारम्भण, i. e. सम्-आ-रभ् + अन, n. = समालम्भन, q. cf.
समाराधन: समाराधन सम्-आ-राध् + अन, n. Winning, gratifying, Ragh. 18, 10.
समारोपण: समारोपण समारोपण, i. e. सम्-आ -रुह्, Caus., + अन, n. Placing or fixing in or on.

सरण्यु: सरण्यु सरण्यु (vb. सृ + अण + य + उ), m.  1. Air, wind.  2. Water.  3. A cloud. -- Cf. Ἐριννύς.
सरमा: सरमा सरमा, f.  1. The bitch of the gods, MBh. 1, 671.  2. The daughter of Dakṣa, Viṣṇu P. 122, n. 19.  3. The wife of Rāvaṇa's brother.
सरयु: सरयु सरयु (vb. सृ),  I. m. Air, wind.  II. f., also यू यू, The name of a river, Rām. 2, 49, 15 (यू).
सरल: सरल सरल (vb. सृ),  I. adj.  1. Straight, Pañc. ii. d. 189.  2. Up-right, honest, Mālat. 38, 1.  II. m. A sort of pine, Pinus longifolia Roxb., Megh. 54.
सरस्: सरस् सरस्, i. e. सृ + अस् (cf. सर),  I. n., and f. सी।  1. A large pond, Pañc. 159, 14 (रस्); Kir. 12, 51 (रसी).  2. A piece of water in which the lotus grows.  II. n. Water.  -- Comp. कर्पूर-, तृण-विन्दु-, n. names of lakes, Hit. 84, 13, M.M. (कर्पूर-); MBh. 3, 15365 (तृणविन्-दु-)। नभस्-, n. clouds, sky, Rām. 5, 55, 4. हिम-, n. cold water, Mālat. 17, 9. -- Cf. O.N. sir, saer, sior (sea); A.S. sirendae.
सरस: सरस सरस, i. e. सरस् + अ, and स-रस,  I. n.  1. A pond.  2. (or m. ?), Alchemy, Rājat. 4, 247.  3. A substitute for सरस् at the end of some comp. words.  II. adj.  1. Tasty, juicy, Megh. 14.  2. Beautiful, charming, Mālat. 51, 5; Bhartṛ. 1, 6; agreeable, Ṛt. 1, 2.  3. New, Śiś. 9, 85.  4. Im-passioned.  5. °सम्, adv. Enraptured, Vikr. 57, 11.
सरसिज: सरसिज सरस् + इ-ज, n. A lotus, Kir. 5, 39.
सरसीरुह: सरसीरुह सरसी-रुह् + अ (see सरस्), n. A lotus, Mālat. 169, 9.
सरस्वत्: सरस्वन्त् सरस् + वन्त्,  I. adj.  1. Juicy, sapid.  2. Elegant.  3. Senti-mental.  II. m.  1. The ocean.  2. A male river.  3. A buffalo.  III. f. वती।  1. The wife of Brahman, the goddess of speech and eloquence, Rājat. 5, 415; of wisdom, Vikr. d. 162.  2. The wife of a Muni.  3. An ex-cellent woman.  4. Speech, Hit. 116, 8; Ragh. 15, 46, ed. Calc.; Rām. 1, 2, 34 (? modulation); the faculty or its exercise.  5. A river.  6. The name of a river, Chr. 20, 24.  7. A crow.
सरस्वन्त्: सरस्वन्त् सरस् + वन्त्,  I. adj.  1. Juicy, sapid.  2. Elegant.  3. Senti-mental.  II. m.  1. The ocean.  2. A male river.  3. A buffalo.  III. f. वती।  1. The wife of Brahman, the goddess of speech and eloquence, Rājat. 5, 415; of wisdom, Vikr. d. 162.  2. The wife of a Muni.  3. An ex-cellent woman.  4. Speech, Hit. 116, 8; Ragh. 15, 46, ed. Calc.; Rām. 1, 2, 34 (? modulation); the faculty or its exercise.  5. A river.  6. The name of a river, Chr. 20, 24.  7. A crow.
सरागता: सरागता स-राग + ता, f. State of being coloured or red, Pañc. i. d. 194.
सरि: सरि सरि, i. e. सृ + इ, f. A water-fall.
सरित्: सरित् सरित्, i. e. सृ + इत् (for सरन्त्, ptcple. pres.), f.  1. A river, Man. 1, 24; Vikr. 68, 5 ( परमार्थ-, Indeed a river).  2. Thread.  -- Comp. कु-, f. a rivulet, Pañc. ii. d. 92. द्यु-, f. the celestial Gaṅgā, Bhartṛ. 3, 85.
सरिमन्: सरिमन् and सरीमन् सरी̆मन् (vb. सृ), m. Wind.
सरीसृप: सरीसृप सरीसृप, i.e/ सरीसृप् (frequent. of सृप्), + अ, m. A snake.
सरोगिता: सरोगिता सरोगिता, i. e. स-रोग + इन् + ता, f. Sickliness, Hit. ii. d. 4.
सरोज: सरोज सरोज, i. e. सरस्-ज, n. A lotus, Śiś. 9, 30; 65.
सरोजिन्: सरोजिन् सरोजिन्, i. e. सरोज + इन्,  I. m. Brahman.  II. f. नी।  1. A lotus, Bhartṛ. 1, 100.  2. A multitude of lotuses.  3. A pond abounding in lotuses.
सरोरुह्: सरोरुह् सरोरुह्, and सरोरुह सरोरुह, n., and -रुहिणि -रुहिणी, f., i. e. सरस्-रुह्, and -रुह् + अ, and + इन् + ई, A lotus, Lass. 73, 15 (ह); Utt. Rāmac. 24, 1 (ह); Kir. 4, 34 (हिणी).
सर्ग: सर्ग सर्ग, i. e. सृज् + अ, m.  1. Abandoning, letting go.  2. Creation, Man. 1, 27.  3. Natural property, nature, Bhag. 5, 19.  4. Certainty,  5. Tendency of a thing.  6. Assent, agreement.  7. Effort, will, Ragh. 3, 51.  8. A chapter, Rām. i. sarga 1, sqq.; a book, Śiś. 1, sqq.  9. Voiding, as of excrement.  -- Comp. आदि-, m. first crea-tion, MBh. 14, 1095. त्रि-, m. the three-fold production (of qualities), Bhāg. P. 1, 1, 1.
सर्ज्: † सर्ज् सर्ज्, i. 1, Par. To gain (cf. अर्ज्).
सर्ज: सर्ज सर्ज, m.  1. A tree, Shorea robusta, Mālat. 148, 14.  2. Another tree, Pentaptera arjuna.  3. The re-sinous exudation of the Shorea robusts, MBh. 1, 5723.
सर्जन: सर्जन सर्जन, i. e. सृज् + अन, n.  1. Abandoning.  2. Creating.  3. Void-ing.  4. The rear or reserve of an army.
सर्जू: सर्जू सर्जू, i. e. सृज् + ऊ,  I. m. A merchant.  II. f.  1. Lightning.  2. A necklace.  3. Going, following.
सर्प: सर्प सर्प, i. e. सृप् + अ,  I. m.  1. Sliding motion.  2. A snake, Man. 1, 37; Pañc. iii. d. 46.  II. f. पी, The female of the snake.  -- Comp. काल-, and कृष्ण-, m. a particular snake, Coluber Naga, Lass. 16, 11; Pañc. i. d. 233. -- Cf. Lat. serpens, ἑρπετός.
सर्पण: सर्पण सर्पण, i. e. सृप् + अन, n.  1. Gliding, going.  2. The slow flight of an arrow nearly parallel to the ground.
सर्पभुज्: सर्पभुज् सर्प-भुज्, m.  1. A pea-cock.  2. A crane.  3. A large snake.
सर्पिन्: सर्पिन् सर्पिन्, i. e. सृप् + इन्,  I. adj., f. इणी।  1. Gliding, creeping.  2. Moving, Kir. 5, 35.  II. f. इणी।  1. A female serpent, Pañc. 210, 12.  2. A small medicinal shrub.  -- Comp. पीठ-, m. a cripple, Man. 8, 394.
सर्पिष्मत्: सर्पिष्मन्त् सर्पिष्मन्त्, i. e. सर्पिस् + मन्त्, adj., f. मती, Seasoned with clarified butter, Utt. Rāmac. 90, 9.
सर्पिष्मन्त्: सर्पिष्मन्त् सर्पिष्मन्त्, i. e. सर्पिस् + मन्त्, adj., f. मती, Seasoned with clarified butter, Utt. Rāmac. 90, 9.
सर्पिस्: सर्पिस् सर्पिस्, i. e. सृप् + इस्, n. Clarified butter, Pañc. iii. d. 27.
सर्ब्: † सर्ब् सर्ब्, सम्ब् सम्ब्, i. 1, Par. To go.
सर्म: सर्म सर्म, i. e. सृ + म, m. Going.
सर्व: सर्व सर्व, probably स + त्र + व,  I. adj., f. वा।  1. All, Nal. 17, 50.  2. Every, Megh. 20; 91.  3. Whole, entire, Pañc. 53, 24.  II. m. Viṣṇu, Śiva.  -- Cf. ὅλος; Lat. soll-ennis, soll-ers, salvus, salus (= ved. सर्व + ताति, ὁλότης).
सर्वंसह: सर्वंसह सर्वंसह, i. e. सर्व + म् -सह् + अ,  I. adj.  1. All-sustaining.  2. Patient, enduring.  II. f. हा, The earth, Govardh. Āryā Saptaśatī, 163, d.
सर्वक: सर्वक सर्व + क, adj. All, every.
सर्वकर्मीण: सर्वकर्मीण सर्वकर्मीण, i. e. सर्व -कर्मन् + ईन, adj. Performing, or con-versant with, every business.
सर्वग: सर्वग सर्व-ग,  I. adj. All-pervading.  II. m.  1. Brahman.  2. Śiva.  3. Soul, spirit.  III. n. Water.
सर्वगतत्व: सर्वगतत्व सर्व-गत + त्व (vb. गम्), n. Omnipresence, Bhāṣāp. 25.
सर्वगुह्यमय: सर्वगुह्यमय सर्व-गुह्य + मय (vb. गुह्), adj. Made up of all mystery, Johns. Sel. 23, 117.
सर्वंकष: सर्वंकष सर्वंकष, i. e. सर्व + म् -कष् + अ,  I. adj. All-pervading, all-subduing, Mālat. 14, 19.  II. m. A rogue.
सर्वजित्: सर्वजित् सर्व-जि + त्, adj.  1. All-subduing, irresistible.  2. All-surpass-ing.
सर्वज्ञ: सर्वज्ञ सर्व-ज्ञ,  I. adj. Omniscient, Hit. 129, 9; Bhartṛ. 2, 8.  II. m. Śiva.  -- Comp. अ-, adj. not omniscient, Rājat. 5, 317.
सर्वज्ञानमय: सर्वज्ञानमय सर्व-ज्ञान + मय, adj., f. य्त्, Containing every knowledge, Man. 2, 7.
सर्वतस्: सर्वतस् सर्व + तस्, adv., and prep. with the acc., Siddh. K. 36, a.  1. From every quarter, Man. 2, 240; from every part, Pañc. iii. d. 51; from everybody, i. d. 156 (cf. Böhhtl. Ind. Spr. 1031).  2. In every direction, Nal. 1, 25.  3. Round about, Chr. 4, 19.  4. Wholly, entirely.
सर्वतेजोमय: सर्वतेजोमय सर्वतेजोमय, i. e. सर्-व-तेजस् + मय, adj., f. यी, Containing every splendour, Man. 7, 11.
सर्वतोदिक्क: सर्वतोदिक्क सर्वतोदिक्क, i. e. सर्-वतस्-दिश् + क, adj. Diffused over all quarters, Rājat. 5, 262.
सर्वतोदिशम्: सर्वतोदिशम् सर्वतोदिशम्, i. e. सर्वतस्-दिश् + अ + म्, adv. To every quarter (of the world), Nal. 16, 5.
सर्वत्र: सर्वत्र सर्व + त्र,  I. = loc. of सर्व, Cāṇ. 48 in Berl. Monatsb. 1864, 410.  II. adv.  1. In all places, everywhere, Pañc. ii. d. 125.  2. At all times, always, Vikr. 30, 14; 39, 14.
सर्वथा: सर्वथा सर्व + था, adv.  1. In all ways, by all means, Pañc. 161, 13; with न, Not at all, Mālat. 154, 13.  2. At every time, Man. 2, 15.  3. Cer-tainly, Vikr. 32, 8.  4. Exceeding, mostly, completely, Hit. 81, 22.
सर्वदा: सर्वदा सर्व + दा, adv. At all times, always, Rām. 6, 10, 23; Pañc. ii. d. 25.
सर्वदेवमय: सर्वदेवमय सर्व-देव + मय, adj., f. यी, Made of, or comprising all, the gods, Pañc. i. d. 136.
सर्वधुरावह: सर्वधुरावह सर्व-धुरा-वह् + अ, and सर्वधुरीण सर्व-धुरीण, m. An ox fit for any carriage or draught.
सर्वंदम: सर्वंदम सर्वंदम, i. e. सर्व + म् -दम् + अ, m. A name of Bharata.
सर्वभूतकृत्: सर्वभूतकृत् सर्व-भूत-कृ + त्, adj. Who or what causes all that exists, Man. 1, 18.
सर्वभूतमय: सर्वभूतमय सर्व-भूत + मय, adj.  I. Comprising all beings, Man. 1, 7.  II. m. The supreme Spirit.
सर्वभूतात्मन्: सर्वभूतात्मन् सर्वभूतात्मन्, i. e. सर्व-भूत-आत्मन्, m. The universal all-pervading Spirit, Man. 1, 54.
सर्वमय: सर्वमय सर्व + मय, adj., f. यी, General, universal, comprehensive.
सर्वमेध्यत्व: सर्वमेध्यत्व सर्व-मेध्य + त्व, n. Perfect purity, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 3296 = Pañc. iii. d. 212.
सर्वर्तुक: सर्वर्तुक सर्वर्तुक, i. e. सर्व-ऋतु + क, adj. Fit for, or inhabitable in, every season, Man. 7, 76.
सर्वशस्: सर्वशस् सर्व + शस्, adv.  1. Uni-versally, everywhere, Johns. Sel. 29, 34.  2. All together, Chr. 37, 1; Nal. 2, 22; 12, 85.
सर्वसिद्धार्थ: सर्वसिद्धार्थ सर्वसिद्धार्थ, i. e. सर्व-सिद्ध (vb. सिध्), -अर्थ, adj. Having every wish attained, Man. 1, 83.
सर्वाङ्गीण: सर्वाङ्गीण सर्वाङ्गीण, i. e. सर्व -अङ्ग + ईन, adj.  1. Spreading through the whole body, spread over all the limbs, Vikr. d. 51; thrilling through the whole body, d. 149.  2. Relating to the Aṅgas or parts of science collec-tively.
सर्वान्नीन: सर्वान्नीन सर्वान्नीन, i. e. सर्व -अन्न + ईन, adj. Eating all sorts of food.
सर्षप: सर्षप सर्षप,  I. m.  1. sort of mustard, Sinapis dichotoma, Win-dischmann, Sankara, 165.  2. A small measure of weight, a mustard seed so considered.  3. A sort of poison.  II. f. पी, A small bird.  -- Comp. गौर-, m. 1. white mustard, Sinapis glauca, Man. 5, 120; Suśr. 1, 16, 10. 2. a measure of weight, Man. 8, 133. रा-जसर्षप, i. e. राजन्-, m. 1. mustard. 2. a measure of weight, Man. 8, 133.
सल्: † सल् सल्, i. 1, Par. To go (cf. सृ).
सलिल: सलिल सलिल (vb. सृ, cf. सर), n. Water, Pañc. 165, 7.  -- Comp. अङ्-तःसलिल, i. e. अन्तर्-, adj., f. ला, con-taining water, Ragh. 3. 9. अ-गाध-, adj. having bottomless water, Pañc. ii. d. 21. नयन-, n. tears, Megh. 40; 88. निःसलिल, i. e. निस्-, adj. deprived of water. Rājat. 1, 33.
सलिलपूरवत्: सलिलपूरवत् सलिल-पूर + वत्, adv. Like a large quantity of water, Pañc. ii. d. 42.
सलिलस्थलचर: सलिलस्थलचर सलिल-स्थल-चर, adj. sbst. Living in water and on the land, Pañc. 131, 12.
सलिलेशय: सलिलेशय सलिलेशय, i. e. सलिल + इ + शी + अ, adj. Lying in water, Lass. 50, 7.
सलोकता: सलोकता स-लोक + ता, f. Condition of dwelling in the same world as, Man. 11, 220.
सव: सव सव, i. e. सु, and सू, + अ,  I. m.  1. Sacrifice.  2. Offspring.  3. The sun.  4. The moon.  II. n.  1. Sprinkling the Soma, or juice of the acid Asclepias.  2. The juice of flowers.  3. Water.  -- Comp. गो-, m. a kind of sacrifice, Man. 11, 74.
सवन: सवन सवन, i. e. सु, and सू, + अन,  I. m. The moon.  II. n.  1. Extracting and drinking the Soma, or juice of the acid Asclepias.  2. A sacrifice, Rām. 1, 13, 5.  3. Bearing children, bringing forth young.
सवितृ: सवितृ सवितृ, i. e. सू + तृ,  I. m. The sun, Vikr. d. 20.  II. f. त्री, A mother.  III. adj. Causing, Kir. 3, 5.
सवृद्धिक: सवृद्धिक स-वृद्धि + क, adj. Bear-ing interest.
सव्य: सव्य सव्य, adj.  1. Left, left hand, Pañc. i. d. 86.  2. Southern, south.  3. Backward, reverse, contrary.  -- Comp. अप-,  I. adj. right (not left), Man. 3, 214; अपसव्यं कृ, to keep the right side towards one, ib.  II. अपसव्यम्, adv. from the left to the right, Man. 3, 279. -- Cf. σκαιός; Lat. scævus. probably also sinister.
सव्यतस्: सव्यतस् सव्य + तस्, adv. On one's left hand, Chr. 31, 14.
सव्यसाचिन्: सव्यसाचिन् सव्यसाचिन्, perhaps सव्य-स-अञ्च् + इन् (cf. साचि), m. (Drawing the bow with his left hand), a name of Arjuna, Pañc. iii. d. 237.
सव्येष्ठृ: सव्येष्ठृ सव्येष्ठृ, i. e. सव्य + इ -स्थार् (स्थार् for स्थान्, with र् for न्, and स्थान् for स्थान्त्, old ptcple. pres. of स्था), m. A charioteer.
सस्: सस् सस्, † शस् शस्, † संस्त् संस्त्, † शंस्त् शंस्त्, ii. 2, Par. To sleep.
सस्य: सस्य सस्य, n.  1. Fruit, Nal. 24, 52 (at the end of a comp. adj., f. या).  2. Corn, grain, Man. 4, 26 (cf. शस्य, under शंस्).  3. A weapon (cf. शस्).  4. A quality, an excellence (cf. शंस्).  -- Cf. perhaps εἴα, ἤϊον.
सस्यक: सस्यक सस्य + क,  I. adj. Possessed of all good qualities.  II. n.  1. A sort of precious stone.  2. A sword.
सह्: 1. सह् सह् (probably a combination of two originally different verbs, viz. सह्, ‘to conquer,’ cf. सहस्, and स -वह्, ‘to bear,’ cf. infin. सोढुम् = स-वोढुम्, ptcple. of the pf. pass. सोढ = स-ऊढ), i. 1, Ātm. (also Par.), and † i. 10, Par.  1. To bear, Vikr. d. 135; Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 997 (Par.); to undergo, Man. 2, 227.  2. To endure, Bhartṛ. 2, 30.  3. To allow, Pañc. 135, 7 (Par.).  4. To forbear (with gen.), Bhag. 11, 44.  5. To be patient, to wait, Ragh. 5, 25.  6. To be able to resist, to oppose, to conquer, Rām. 1, 22, 21.  7. To stop, Rām. 2, 24, 27.  8. To be able (with infin.), Hit. ii. d. 139. Comp, ptcple. of the pres, अ-सहमान, adj. Not able to endure, Pañc. 221, 1. Ptcple. of the pf. pass, सोढ।  1. Borne, endured.  2. Patient, enduring. सहित, see s.v. Ptcple. of the fut. pass. सह्य।  1. Equal or ade-quate to, Pañc. ii. d. 200 (but cf. my transl. n. 907).  2. Sweet, agree-able; see also s.v.  Comp. अ-सह्य, adj. 1. insupportable, Ṛt. 1. 10. 2. un-conquerable, Ragh. 18, 24. -- With the prep. अभि अभि, absol. अभिषह्य, Forcibly, Man. 8, 367. -- With उद् उद्,  1. To make an effort or exertion, Bhaṭṭ. 19, 16.  2. To dare, Pañc. 22, 1; with acc., To dare to pursue, Nal. 4, 16.  3. To be able (with infin. and dat. of an abstract noun), Rām. 3, 51, 17; MBh. 3, 16543 (परिभोगाय, To enjoy).  -- With अभ्युद् अभि-उद्, To be able, to wish, Ragh. 5, 22. -- With प्रोद् प्र -उद्, Caus. To incite, to instigate, Rām. 2, 9, 46. -- With समुद् सम्-उद्, Caus. To incite, MBh. 2, 1412. -- With प्र प्र,  1. To make an effort, Pañc. iii. d. 51.  2. To endure, Utt. Rāmac. 148, 5; absolut. प्रसह्य, Violently, Man. 8, 235.  3. To overpower, Rām. 2, 5;, 7.  4. सीमन्तित: सीमन्तित सीमन्तित, i. e. ptcple. pf. pass. of a denomin. सीमन्तय, derived from सीमन्त, Marked by a line, Kir. 4, 18.
सीमन्तिनी: सीमन्तिनी सीमन्तिनी, i. e. सीमन्त + इन् + ई, f. A woman, Hit. ii. d. 6.
सीर: सीर सीर (vb. सि, cf. सीता), m.  1. A plough, Megh. 16.  2. The sun.
सीरिन्: सीरिन् सीरिन्, i. e. सीर + इन्, m. Baladeva, Śiś. 2, 2.  -- Comp. अर्ध-, i. e. अर्धसीर + इन्, m. A cultivator who takes half the crop for his labour, Yājñ. 1, 166.
सीवन: सीवन सीवन, i. e. सिव् + अन,  I. n. Sewing, stitching.  II. f. नी, The frenum of the prepuce.
सीस: सीस सीस, सीसक सीस + क, and सीसपत्रक सीस-पत्र + क, n. Lead, Man. 5, 114 (सक).
सु: 1. सु सु, i. 1, and ii. 2, Par., and सू सू, ii. 4, सुय (properly pass. refl. of सु), and ii. 2, Ātm.  1. To beget, Man. 10, 32.  2. Chil-dren, Man. 2, 28.  Comp. गिरि-, f. ता, Pārvatī, Pañc. i. d. 175. जह्नु-, f. ता, the Gaṅgā, MBh. 1, 3913. जीव-, adj. one who has living children, Bhāg. P. 6, 19, 25. दार-, m. wife and son, Yājñ. 2, 175. दासी-, m. a base man, Rājat. 5, 179. धर्म-, m. (the son of the god Dharma), epithet of Yudhiṣṭhira, Bhāg. P. 1, 7, 49. भू- and मही-, m. the planet Mars. भृगु-, m. 1. Śukra or Venus. 2. Paraśurāma. राधा-, m. Karṇa. शैल-, f. ता, Pārvatī, Vikr. d. 128.  II. सूल,  1. Engendered.  2. Born. f. ता,  1. A daughter, Pañc. 181, 5.  2. A woman lying in; see s.v.  Comp. सूर-, m. Aruṇa, the dawn.  III. सून,  1. Born, produced.  2. Blown, budded (as a flower). m. A son, Pañc. 198, 2. f. ना, A daughter. n.  1. Bringing forth, parturition.  2. A flower. -- With the prep. अभि अभि, षु,  1. To express the Soma juice, Rām. 1, 13, 5 (cf. Schlegel's translation).  2. To extract juice, Man. 5, 10.  3. To sprinkle, Bhaṭṭ. 9, 90. -- With उद् उद्, ii. 5, To agitate, Bhāg. P. 3, 20, 35 (cf. 2. सू). --With प्र प्र,  1. To beget, Man. 10, 30.  2. To bring forth, Man. 4, 44.  3. Pass. To be brought forth, Man, 10, 36; with the termination of the Par. (i. 4, Par.), MBh. 12, 5687. प्रसूत,  1. En-gendered, Hit. pr. d. 23, M.M.  2. Born, Pañc. 45, 2.  3. Produced, Chr. 294, 8 = Rigv. i. 92, 8.  4. En-gendering, Man. 3, 19.  5. Having brought forth, delivered, Hit. 72, 14; Utt. Rāmac. 52, 1 (she has brought forth).  Comp. अ-, adj. one who has not brought forth, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 809. कुल-, adj. descended from a respectable family, Pañc. pr. d. 6. प्रसून, Born, produced. n.  1. A bud, a blossom, Utt. Rāmac. 129, 12; flower, Mālat. 57, 13.  2. Fruit.  Comp. विस-, n. a lotus. -- With संप्र सम्-प्र,  1. To beget, Man. 10, 33.  2. Pass. To be brought forth, MBh. 3, 12978 (with the termination of the Par.). -- Cf. ὕω, υἱός, ὑστέρα; Goth. sunus; A.S. sunu (cf. सूनु).
2. सु सु, i. 1, and ii. 2, Par. † To possess power or supremacy (cf. the last).
3. सु सु, i. 1, Par. Ātm. † To go.

4. सु सु (for original वसु, cf. εὖ, ἐΰς; ἐάων = Zend. वङ्ह्वाम् = Sskr. *वस्-वाम्),  I. adv. ved. Beautifully, Chr. 296, 1 = Rigv. i. 112, 1.  II. Very seldom combined and compounded with a verbum finitum; e. g. Pañc. i. d. 205, but cf. Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 647; but very often with nouns,  1. Good, well, Rām. 3, 53, 6; Ṛt. 6, 2; Lass. 15, 5.  2. With न, Very badly, Pañc. 199, 24; with मा, In no way, Megh. 108.  3. More, Śiś. 9, 67; Pañc. 163, 3.  4. Exceedingly, Śiś. 9, 55.  5. Consequently, of course. -- Cf. εὖ.
सुकालिन्: सुकालिन् सुकालिन्, probably सु -2. काल + इन्, m. pl. The Manes of the Śūdras, Man. 3, 197.
सुकृत्: सुकृत् सु-कृ + त्, adj.  1. Virtuous, pious, Chr. 294, 3 = Rigv. i. 92, 3; Pañc. ii. d. 170.  2. Fortunate.
सुख्: सुख् सुख्, i. 10, सुखय (rather a denomin. derived from the next), Par. To make happy, to comfort, Megh. 86; to delight, Vikr. d. 61; MBh. 3, 181; Hit. i. d. 96, M.M. सुखित (ptcple. pf. pass., or सुख + इत), Pleased, Vikr. 59, 1; happy, Śāk. d. 99. n. Happiness, Mālav. 33, 3.

Easi-ness, see  II.  4. 5. Paradise.  6. Water.  -- Comp. अ-,  I. adj. 1. unhappy, MBh. 1, 3984. 2. difficult, Kir. 5, 49.  II. n. distress, Pañc. ii. d. 191. अ-निर्दे-श्य- (vb. दिश्), adj. having inexpressible pleasure, Vikr. d. 59. अन्तःसुख, i. e. अन्तर्-, adj. one who derives his happiness from his soul, Bhag. 5, 24. ग्राम- and ग्राम्य-, n. pleasure of common people, sexual intercourse, MBh. 5, 3225; 3226. निस्-, adj. sad, MBh. 5, 2379. यथा-सुख + म्, adv. 1. happily, Hit. 95, 1, M.M. 2. wil-lingly, Nal. 23, 9.

सुखस्थ: सुखस्थ सुख-स्थ (vb. स्था), adj. Happy, Pañc. i. d. 406.
सुखिन्: सुखिन् सुखिन्, i. e. सुख + इन्,  I. adj., f. नी।  1. Happy, Pañc. 262, 10.  2. Glad, Hit. 78, 3.  3. Pleasant.  4. Comfortable (corpulent), Hit. 106, 16.  II. m. A religious ascetic.
सुखोद्य: सुखोद्य सुखोद्य, i. e. सुख-उद्य (ptcple. of the fut. pass. of वद्), adj. To be uttered agreeably, Man. 2, 33.

Lat. se, suns; Goth. sve, sik, seina; A.S. sín; σϕέ, ἕ, εἷο, ἑός; A.S. swa.

स्वच्छक: स्वच्छक स्वच्छक, i. e. सु-अच्छ + क, adj. White, beautiful, Pañc. i. d. 225 (pure = harmless ?).
स्वज: स्वज स्व-ज,  I. adj. Self-born or pro-duced.  II. m.  1. A son.  2. Perspi-ration.  III. f. जा, A daughter.  IV. n. Blood.
स्वजनाय: स्वजनाय स्वजनाय, a deno-min. derived from स्व-जन with य, Ātm. To become a relation, Pañc. i. d. 5.
स्वञ्ज्: स्वञ्ज् स्वञ्ज्, (probably from स्व), i. 1, स्वज, Ātm. स्वद्: स्वद् स्वद्, i. e. probably सु-अद्,
स्वाद्: स्वाद् स्वाद्, i. 1, Ātm.  1. To taste, to eat, MBh. 1, 3362.  2. To please, to be liked, Śiś. 10, 23. स्वादनीय, Savoury, Indr. 1, 26. i. 10, Par.  1. स्वधाभुज्: स्वधाभुज् स्वधा-भुज्, m.  1. A deified ancestor.  2. A deity.
स्वधिति: स्वधिति स्वधिति, m. and f., also ती ती, An axe.
स्वधितीवत्: स्वधितीवन्त् स्वधिती + वन्त्, adj. Armed with an axe, Chr. 293, 2 = Rigv. i. 88, 2.
स्वधितीवन्त्: स्वधितीवन्त् स्वधिती + वन्त्, adj. Armed with an axe, Chr. 293, 2 = Rigv. i. 88, 2.
स्वन्: स्वन् स्वन्, i. 1, Par. To sound, e. g. to sing, Rām. 2, 65, 5. Ptcple. of the pf. pass.  I. स्वनित, Sounding. n. The noise of thunder.  II. स्वान्त, Sounded. Caus. स्व्ăनय, †  1. To cause to sound.  2. † To sound.  3. and स्वानय, † To adorn. -- With the prep. अव अव, or वि वि, To make a noise when eating; in this signification the vb. is changed to ष्वण्। -- With नि नि, निस्वनित, n. Noise, MBh. 7, 324.  -- Cf. Lat. sonare.
स्वन: स्वन स्वन् + अ, m. II. m. 1. a loud sound. 2. a kind of drum. महा-मेघ-, adj. having the sound of a large cloud, Indr. 1, 5. -- Cf. Lat. sonus.
स्वनि: स्वनि स्वन् + इ, m. Sound, Mahāv. 132, 19.
स्वनिक: ऽस्वनिक -स्वनिक in पाणि-, i. e. पाणि -स्वन + इक, m. One who claps the hands, MBh. 12, 1899.
स्वप्: स्वप् स्वप्, ii. 2 (i. 1, Man. 4, 99), Par. (in epic poetry also Ātm., MBh. 3, 15993),  1. To sleep, Man. 1, 25.  2. To fall asleep, MBh. 2, 2027.  3. Having slept, Sāv. 5, 64.  2. Sleeping, Vikr. d. 135.  3. Senseless. n. Sleep. Beginning to sleep, Pañc. 134, 6; gone to bed, Pañc. 117, 12.  2. Fallen asleep, Chr. 38, 6.  3. Slept, Sāv. 5, 65.  4. Sleeping, Daśak. in Chr. 199, 6. --With संप्र सम्-प्र, To sleep, MBh. 1, 955. -- With सम् सम्, To sleep, MBh. 1, 5967. -- Cf. Lat. sopire (Caus.); A.S. swefian; O.H.G. suabjan, suebjan; ὔπαρ; see स्वप्न, also with ल् for व् (cf. श्वस्); Goth. slêpan; A.S. slápan.

स्वप्न: स्वप्न स्वप् + न, m.  1. Sleep, Ve-dāntas. in Chr. 208, 6.  2. Indolence, Man. 12, 33.  3. Dreaming.  4. स्वप्नज्: स्वप्नज् स्वप्न-ज् (ज्, from vb. जन्), adj. Sleeping, asleep, MBh. 3, 10648.
स्वप्नज: स्वप्नज स्वप्न-ज, adj. Produced by a dream, Megh. 88.

स्वाध्यायवन्त्: स्वाध्यायवन्त् स्वाध्यायवन्त्, i. e. स्व-अध्याय + वन्त्, m. A student of the Vedas, Johns. Sel. 36, 12.
स्वाध्यायिन्: स्वाध्यायिन् स्वाध्यायिन्, i. e. स्व -अध्याय + इन्,  1. A student of the Ve-das.  2. A tradesman.
स्वान: स्वान स्वान, i. e. स्वन् + अ, m. Sound.
स्वान्त: स्वान्त स्वान्त,  I. See स्वन्।  II. i. e. स्व-अन्त, n.  1. The mind, Vedāntas. in Chr. 202, 12; Bhartṛ. 3, 92.  2. A cavern.
स्वाप: स्वाप स्वाप, i. e. स्वप् + अ, m.  1. Sleeping, Utt. Rāmac. 24, 7; sleep.  2. Sleepiness.  3. Loss of sensation.  4. The sleep of a limb.  5. Ignorance.  6. Dream.  -- Comp. दिवा-, m. sleeping by day, Suśr. 1, 330, 5.
स्वापतेय: स्वापतेय स्वापतेय, i. e. स्व-पति + एय, n. Wealth, MBh. 1, 1781; Pañc. ii. d. 166.
स्वाभाविक: स्वाभाविक स्वाभाविक, i. e. स्व-भाव + इक, adj. Being by one's own nature, inherent, natural, Man. 3, 46; Pañc. 66, 10; 110, 21.
स्वामिक: ऽस्वामिक -स्वामिक, i. e. स्वामिन् + क, a substitute for स्वामिन्, when latter part of a comp. adj.; e. g. प्रनष्ट-(so to be read instead of प्रणष्ट, Man. 8, 30), adj. That of which it is not known whether its owner is alive or dead.
स्वामित्व: स्वामित्व स्वामित्व, i. e. स्वामिन् + त्व, n.  1. Ownership.  2. Sovereignty, Pañc. 163, 14.
स्वामिन्: स्वामिन् स्वामिन्, i. e. स्व + मिन्, m.  1. A proprietor.  2. A master, Pañc. i. d. 328.  3. A sovereign, Hit. 3, 4, M.M.  4. A husband, Hit. 87, 9, M.M.; a lover.  5. A spiritual preceptor.  6. A learned Brāhmaṇa.  7. Viṣṇu, Śiva, Kārttikeya, the god of war, Garuḍa, a fabulous bird.  8. In comp. it signifies often a sanctuary built by, or in honour of those who are denoted in the former part of the comp.; e. g. अवन्ति-, m. a sanctuary built by Avan-tivarman, Rājat. 5, 45. अभिमन्यु-, m. A sanctuary built in commemoration of Abhimanyu, Rājat. 6, 299. धर्म-, m. A sanctuary built by Dharma, Rājat. 4, 696. विष्णु-, A sanctuary built in honour of Viṣṇu, Rājat. 5, 99.  -- Comp. अ-, m. one who is not owner, Man. 8, 4. कु-, m. a wicked master, Pañc. 73, 11. गो-, m. 1. the owner of cattle, Man. 8, 231. 2. a holy man, used after proper names, as a honorary title. जगत्-, m. the lord of the uni-verse, Prab. 99, 8. जय-, m. the lord of victory, epithet of Śiva, Rājat. 5, 448. रण-, m. the lord of battles, epithet of Śiva, Rājat. 5, 394. शिव-, m. a proper name, Rājat. 5, 34.
स्वाम्य: स्वाम्य स्वाम्य, i. e. स्वामिन् + य, n.  1. Ownership.  2. Mastership.  3. Su-premacy, Hit. 84, 7; dominion, Dev. 1, 8.  4. Marital dominion, Man. 5, 152.
स्वायम्भुव: स्वायम्भुव स्वायम्भुव, i. e. स्वयं-भू + अ,  I. adj.  1. Relating to Brahman.  2. Descended from Brahman.  II. m. The son of Brahman, Śāk. d. 168; epithet of the first Manu, Man. 1, 61; 63.
स्वायुज्: स्वायुज् स्वायुज्, i. e. सु, or स्व, -आ-युज्, adj. Easily yoked, or putting themselves spontaneously to the chariot, Chr. 294, 2 = Rigv. i. 92, 2.
स्वाराज्: स्वाराज् स्वाराज्, i. e. स्वर्-राज्, m. Indra.
स्वाराज्य: स्वाराज्य स्वाराज्य, n., i. e.  I. स्व-राज् + य, The state of Brahman, union with Brahman, final felicity, Man. 12, 91.  II. स्वाराज् + य, Indra's heaven.
स्वारोचिष: स्वारोचिष स्वारोचिष, i. e. स्व -रोचिस् + अ, m. The second Manu, Man. 1, 62.
स्वार्थिक: स्वार्थिक स्वार्थिक, i. e. स्व-अर्थ + इक, adj.  1. Done with one's own pro-perty.  2. Having one's own object.  3. Having its literal meaning.
स्वास्थ्य: स्वास्थ्य स्वास्थ्य, i. e. स्वस्थ + य, n.  1. Health, Pañc. 183, 22.  2. Con-tent.  3. Happiness, Pañc. ii. d. 165.  4. Self-reliance, firmness, Pañc. ii. d. 170 (with व्रज्, To recover).
स्वाहा: स्वाहा स्वाहा,  I. indecl. An excla-mation on offering to the gods.  II. f. A personification of the preceding as the wife of fire, Ragh. 1, 56.
स्विद्: 1. स्विद् स्विद्, i. 4, Par. To per-spire, to sweat, Gīt. 10, 16. i. 1, Ātm.  1. † To be greasy or unctuous.  2. † To be disturbed.  3. † To shed. Ptcple. of the pf. pass.  I. स्विदित,  1. Sweated, melted.  2. Perspiring.  II. स्विन्न, Sweating, Lass. 59, 6. Caus.  1. To cause to perspire; स्वेद्य, What must be treated by sudorific means, Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 890.  2. To warm, Hit. ii. d. 131. स्वेदित, Sweated, heated. -- With प्र प्र, प्रस्विन्न, and प्रस्वेदिन्द्,  1. Perspiring, covered with perspiration, Rām. 2, 100, 35 (स्विन्न).  2. Heated; प्रस्वेदित (also  3.), Hot, causing perspiration. -- Cf. Goth. svei-tan; A.S. swaetan; O.H.G. svizzan, sueizjan (Caus.); ιδρώς, σίδηρος; Lat. sudor, sudare.

2. स्विद् स्विद्, i. e. सु-इद्,  1. A particle used in an interrogation, Perhaps, Kir. 12, 15; 14, 60; after किम्, MBh. 3, 10648; after उत and उताहो (see उत), Or, Pañc. 41, 1; 142, 5.  2. An exclamation of doubt or surprise.
स्विष्टकृत्: स्विष्टकृत् स्विष्टकृत्, i. e. सु-इष्ट (vb. यज्), -कृ + त्, The name of a divinity, the fire of the good sacrifice, Man. 3, 86.
स्वीकरण: स्वीकरण स्वीकरण, i. e. स्व-कृ + अन, n.  1. Assenting.  2. Promising.  3. Marriage, Śāk. 66, 17.
स्वीकार: स्वीकार स्वीकार, i. e. स्व-कृ + अ, m.  1. Assent.  2. Promise.
स्वीय: स्वीय स्वीय, i. e. स्व + ईय,  I. adj. Own, Pañc. ii. d. 80.  II. f. या, A faithful. wife. -- Cf. ἑός, σϕέος, σϕός.
स्वृ: स्वृ स्वृ, i. 1, Par.  1. To sound.  2. To praise (ved.).  3. To be pained.  4. † To go. Caus. To sing, Chr. 294, 5 = Rigv. i. 88, 5 (सस्वर्, ved. aor.). --With सम् सम्, Ātm. To pain, Bhaṭṭ. 9, 28. -- Cf. Lat. susurro, absurdus, surdus (properly, Suffering from humming in the ears), sorex; σύριγξ, ὕραξ, ὕρον; pro-bably Goth. svaran; A.S. swaran, swe-rian, and-swar, answer; probably Lat. sorbere; ῥοϕέω (from the sound of drink-ing; cf. Zend. क़र् = Sskr. स्वर्, pro-perly, To smack; cf. अव and वि, with स्वन्, also विष्वणन, विष्वाण).
स्वॄ: † स्वॄ स्वॄ, स्वॄ स्बॄ, सॄ सॄ, ii. 9, स्वृणा, स्बृणा, सृणा, णी, Par. To hurt, to kill.
स्वेच्छातस्: स्वेच्छातस् स्वेच्छातस्, i. e. स्व -इच्छा + तस्, adv. Conformably to one's wish, Hit. 69, 19.
स्वेद: स्वेद स्वेद, i. e. स्विद् + अ, m.  1. Per-spiration, sweat, Vikr. 27, 2.  2. Hot moisture, Vedāntas. in Chr. 209, 5.  3. Warmth.  4. Hot work, labour, Chr. 292, 8 = Rigv. i. 86, 8.  5. Vapour.  -- Comp. स-,  I. adj. perspiring, exuding, Rājat. 5, 343.  II. f. दा, a virgin de-flowered. -- Cf. O.H.G. sueiz; A.S. swát.
स्वेदन: स्वेदन स्वेदन, i. e. स्विद् + अन,  I. n.  1. Perspiration.  2. Causing to perspire, warming, Hit. ii. d. 130.  3. A sudorific.  II. f. नी, An iron plate used for cook-ing and frying.
स्वेदनिक: स्वेदनिक स्वेदनिक, i. e. स्वेदनी + क, f. An iron plate for cooking and frying.
स्वैर: स्वैर स्वैर (from स्व and ईर्),  I. adj.  1. Self-willed, Pañc. 31, 3; of one's own accord, Rām. 3, 52, 27 (without the permission of her husband); un-restrained.  2. Slow, or refractory, Nal. 21, 13; Sāv. 5, 98.  3. Dependent on one's will, unimportant, MBh. 1, 1726; 1921; 3, 13573.  II. रम्, adv.  1. With one's own will, assent, Rām. 3, 52, 27; Utt. Rāmac. 29, 6; Kathās. 22, 99.  2. Of one's own accord, Rājat. 5, 411.  III. n. Wilfulness.
स्वैरता: स्वैरता स्वैर + ता, and स्वैरिता स्वैरिता, i. e. स्वैरिन् + ता, f. Wilfulness, Lass. 2. ed. 19, 18 (र).
स्वैरिन्: स्वैरिन् स्वैरिन्, i. e. स्वैर + इन्,  I. adj., f. इणी, Self-willed, wanton, Lass. 42, 13.  II. f. इणी, An unchaste woman, Pañc. 129, 1; Rājat. 5, 316.
